paper_id: Steganographic visual story with mutual-perceived joint attention
title: Steganographic visual story with mutual-perceived joint attention
venue: EURASIP Journal on Image and Video Processing
motivation: 社交媒体易传播难追踪，用户需在透明环境下安全交换敏感信息
problem_framing: 用视觉故事生成代替传统文本隐写，将秘密信息嵌入自动生成的图片叙事中
key_insight: 通过互感知联合注意力(MPJA)建模图像与文本的相互感知关系，动态调整每词嵌入位数以保语义
method_signature: ResNet+Bi-LSTM编码图像序列 + MPJA跨模态注意力 + 自适应变长隐写
evaluation_criteria: BLEU/METEOR评估文本质量；t-SNE语义空间分布和CNN检测准确率评估安全性；人类主观评判
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 固定长度嵌入导致文本质量急剧下降；图像压缩会轻微影响提取准确性
evidence_for_taste: the quality of generated text decreases as ER increases
fixed-length secret bits...not all the words in sentences are suitable
force embedding will only make the quality of generated text poor
the stego text is indistinguishable from the text created by humans
accuracy of correct discrimination is similar to random guessing
thinking_moves: 把隐写问题重新定义为视觉叙事生成问题
用图像序列替代词作为解码密钥以提高鲁棒性
通过方差阈值自适应选择每词嵌入位数以保持语义连贯
